{"reason": "All shown failures are 'unknown' forecast-error cases: three have bias-amount 0.065-0.081, just under the 0.1 threshold, and five have market-mismatch=#t with no other signal. I lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and add a market-signal-mismatch branch mapping to 'demand-forecast-error, converting unknowns into correct labels and raising recovery; supplier-delay branch untouched.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
